decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed activity centre would be a trip generating use but fail to provide off street parking and also would also be located in an out of town location inaccessible by public transport. This is an unsuitable proposal contrary to Policies C.5.1 (New Leisure Development) T.1.2 (The movement implications of development) IMP.1.1 (Integrating Patterns of Land Use and the Provision of Transport) and T.1.1 (The Location of Development) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003.

Condition : 2 - The proposed activity centre is unable to provide off street parking to meet the Council's Parking Standards, when combined with the inaccessibility to public transport, it will result in on street parking, have adverse affect upon road safety and an adverse affect upon the amenity of adjoining residential occupiers. This is contrary to policies T.1.4 (Car and Cycling Parking, and servicing for developments) and T.4.3 (Traffic Implications of New Development) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003.
description: Change of use from B1 (office) to childrens activity / playcentre (d2)
